response.sql: SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) as avg_file_size_per_minute FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND scans.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY sites.riskeval ORDER BY sites.riskeval

assumptions.assumption: chronotag is stored in a text format that supports plain text string comparison with the provided ISO 8601 date strings
Rows with NULL gbsize or spanmin values are excluded from averaging per the 'ignore missing values' instruction
Rows with spanmin <= 0 are excluded to prevent invalid division by zero or negative scan durations
